12: /// Checks for uses of the builtin `exec` function.
13: ///
14: /// ## Why is this bad?
15: /// The `exec()` function is insecure as it allows for arbitrary code
16: /// execution.
17: ///
18: /// ## Example
19: /// ```python
20: /// exec("print('Hello World')")
21: /// ```
22: ///
23: /// ## References
24: /// - [Python documentation: `exec`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#exec)
25: /// - [Common Weakness Enumeration: CWE-78](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/78.html)
26: #[derive(ViolationMetadata)]
27: pub(crate) struct ExecBuiltin;
28: 
29: impl Violation for ExecBuiltin {
30:     #[derive_message_formats]
31:     fn message(&self) -> String {
32:         "Use of `exec` detected".to_string()
33:     }
34: }
35: 
36: /// S102
37: pub(crate) fn exec_used(checker: &mut Checker, func: &Expr) {
38:     let reports_exec_builtin = {
39:         let semantic = checker.semantic();
40: 
41:         let mut current = func;
42:         let head = loop {
43:             match current {
44:                 Expr::Attribute(attribute) => {
45:                     current = attribute.value.as_ref();
46:                 }
47:                 Expr::Name(name) => break name,
48:                 _ => return,
49:             }
50:         };
51: 
52:         let Some(binding_id) = semantic
53:             .resolve_name(head)
54:             .or_else(|| semantic.lookup_symbol(&head.id))
55:         else {
56:             return;
57:         };
58:         let binding = semantic.binding(binding_id);
59: 
60:         let Some(unqualified_name) = UnqualifiedName::from_expr(func) else {
61:             return;
62:         };
63:         let unqualified_segments = unqualified_name.segments();
64:         let tail = &unqualified_segments[1..];
65: 
66:         let resolved = match &binding.kind {
67:             BindingKind::Import(Import { qualified_name }) => {
68:                 let mut resolved: Vec<&str> = qualified_name.segments().iter().copied().collect();
69:                 resolved.extend(tail.iter().copied());
70:                 Some(resolved)
71:             }
72:             BindingKind::SubmoduleImport(SubmoduleImport { qualified_name }) => {
73:                 let mut resolved: Vec<&str> =
74:                     qualified_name.segments().iter().copied().take(1).collect();
75:                 resolved.extend(tail.iter().copied());
76:                 Some(resolved)
77:             }
78:             BindingKind::FromImport(FromImport { qualified_name }) => {
79:                 let import_segments = qualified_name.segments();
80:                 if import_segments.first().copied() == Some(".") {
81:                     semantic
82:                         .resolve_qualified_name(func)
83:                         .map(|qualified_name| qualified_name.segments().iter().copied().collect())
84:                 } else {
85:                     let mut resolved: Vec<&str> = import_segments.iter().copied().collect();
86:                     resolved.extend(tail.iter().copied());
87:                     Some(resolved)
88:                 }
89:             }
90:             BindingKind::Builtin => {
91:                 if func.is_name_expr() {
92:                     Some(vec!["", head.id.as_str()])
93:                 } else {
94:                     let mut resolved = vec![""];
95:                     resolved.extend(unqualified_segments.iter().copied());
96:                     Some(resolved)
97:                 }
98:             }
99:             _ => semantic
100:                 .resolve_qualified_name(func)
101:                 .map(|qualified_name| qualified_name.segments().iter().copied().collect()),
102:         };
103: 
104:         if let Some(resolved) = resolved {
105:             if let [module_name, member_name] = resolved.as_slice() {
106:                 if *member_name == "exec" {
107:                     if module_name.is_empty() {
108:                         true
109:                     } else if *module_name == "builtin" {
110:                         true
111:                     } else {
112:                         false
113:                     }
114:                 } else {
115:                     false
116:                 }
117:             } else {
118:                 false
119:             }
120:         } else {
121:             false
122:         }
123:     };
124: 
125:     if reports_exec_builtin {
126:         checker
127:             .diagnostics
128:             .push(Diagnostic::new(ExecBuiltin, func.range()));
129:     }
130: }
